import json, hashlib

d = json.load(open("sbom.spdx.json"))

# structural checks
assert d["spdxVersion"] == "SPDX-2.3"
assert d["dataLicense"] == "CC0-1.0"
assert d["packages"][0]["licenseDeclared"] == "MIT"
assert len(d["hasExtractedLicensingInfos"]) == 1

# verify every file's checksum matches the actual file on disk
for f in d["files"]:
    data = open(f["fileName"][2:], "rb").read()
    for c in f["checksums"]:
        h = hashlib.sha1(data).hexdigest() if c["algorithm"] == "SHA1" else hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
        assert c["checksumValue"] == h, f"checksum mismatch for {f['fileName']}"
    ev = f.get("evidence", {})
    assert "licenseEvidence" in ev or f["licenseConcluded"] == "NOASSERTION"
    assert "packageFileEvidence" in ev
    # evidence checksums must match file checksums
    for pfe in ev["packageFileEvidence"]:
        assert pfe["fileChecksums"] == f["checksums"]

# every spdx id referenced in relationships must exist
ids = {d["SPDXID"], d["packages"][0]["SPDXID"]} | {f["SPDXID"] for f in d["files"]}
for r in d["relationships"]:
    assert r["spdxElementId"] in ids, r
    assert r["relatedSpdxElement"] in ids, r

print("All checks passed")
print("files covered:", len(d["files"]))
for f in d["files"]:
    print(f"  {f['fileName']:32} lic={f['licenseConcluded']:12} checksums={len(f['checksums'])} evidence={list(f['evidence'].keys())}")
EOF
